data.name: Positive Energy ~ Cleric
data.description: You can unleash a wave of positive energy. You must choose to deal %1d%2 points of positive energy damage to undead creatures or to heal living creatures of %1d%2 points of damage. Creatures that take damage from channeled energy receive a DC %3 Will save to halve the damage.|ClericChannelPositiveEnergyDice|ClericChannelPositiveEnergyDieSize|ClericChannelPositiveEnergyDC
